limitations: Historical synthetic/model calibration only; no new scientific adjudication or nature-level inference.

legacy.claim: The shifted-field chance-alignment estimator R = N_shift/N_real, evaluated on the nonuniform-footprint synthetic population with known injected field-star contamination fractions (5%, 10%, 20%) and RA-wrap/polar field placements, recovers each injected fraction within the predeclared tolerance (+/-0.05 absolute at 5%, +/-25% relative at 10% and 20%).
legacy.kill: R_chance falls outside the predeclared tolerance band for any injected-contamination arm or any field placement (equatorial baseline, RA-wrap, polar).
legacy.evidence: ORB-11222's cataloged frozen run at Orrery 28dd5c72 passes the 5% arms but under-recovers every planted 10%/20% rate; this failed control is unresolved calibration evidence, not a gravity claim. ORB-11241 owns diagnosis.
